evidence.excerpt:
## `login`/`logout` removed from Crossplane CLI

The `crossplane xpkg login` and `crossplane xpkg logout` commands have been removed from the Crossplane CLI. To login to a registry before pushing a package, consider using `docker login` locally, or the [`docker/login-action`](https://github.com/docker/login-action) from CI.

An example of this pattern can be seen in many Community Extension Projects, for example [`function-auto-ready`](https://github.com/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L168-L173).
